The Linear changelog has several 2025 entries about its MCP server:

I found 31 changelog entries dated 2025 and checked each one's own page. 25 of them have API or MCP items. Dates come from the entry URLs, which are the release dates. Linear lists some of these under "Improvements" or "Fixes" instead of its own API or MCP section, and I've included those. Each entry's API or MCP section is one list in the changelog. Where a section had several items, I've grouped them into one line.

| Date | Title | API / MCP part |
|---|---|---|
| Jan 23 | [Pull request reviews](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-01-23-pull-request-reviews) | GraphQL: `addedLabelIds` and `removedLabelIds` on `IssueUpdateInput`, a `containsIgnoreCaseAndAccent` comparator, and `Customer.integration`. Removed `ProjectLink`, `Document.contentData` and `ProjectMilestone.descriptionData`, plus `message` on `OrganizationInviteCreateInput`. Fix: guests can no longer install OAuth apps. |
| Feb 13 | [Initiative updates](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-02-13-initiative-updates) | 7 API items. These cover initiative filters, project dependency relations, and `projectUpdate.isStale`. Webhooks now cover Customer and CustomerNeed and include the issue identifier and URL. New `X-Ratelimit-Endpoint-*` rate-limit headers. |
| Mar 6 | [Sub-teams](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-03-06-sub-teams) | Customers can be upserted by tier name and loaded by slug ID. Webhooks now fire for initiatives and initiative updates. |
| Apr 3 | [Collapsed issue history](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-03-collapsed-issue-history) | Fix only: the `iconUrl` set on an attachment through the API now displays. |
| Apr 10 | [New search](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-10-new-search) | Personal API keys get granular permissions. OAuth supports PKCE without a client secret. Some `UserUpdateInput` fields are deprecated. |
| Apr 16 | [Pulse](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-04-16-pulse) | Breaking: a regular label can no longer become a group label by setting `parentId`. Group labels need `isGroup: true` at creation. |
| May 1 | [Linear MCP server](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-01-mcp) | **Launch of the official MCP server.** It is remote, hosted and authenticated, and works natively in Claude or through `mcp-remote` in Cursor, Windsurf and others. |
| May 15 | [Custom feeds in Pulse](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-15-custom-feeds-in-pulse) | MCP issue tools gain priority, due date, assignee, project, label management, and start/target/due dates. `reactionCreate` accepts emoji. User webhooks include the profile URL. Apps must re-authorize to receive webhooks if they enable them later. |
| May 20 | [Linear for Agents](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-05-20-linear-for-agents) | New Agent API for building agents, with docs and a `#api-agents` community channel. |
| Jun 5 | [Asks fields and Triage routing](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-06-05-asks-fields-and-triage-routing) | The MCP server supports Cursor 1.0 one-click install with OAuth2. | Jul 17 | [Email intake for Asks](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-17-email-intake-for-asks) | MCP: `Issue.delegate` is included, and the model is told when responses have multiple pages. API: `fromDelegate` and `toDelegate` on `IssueHistory`, two new webhook IPs (signature verification is preferred), and faster webhook delivery. |
| Jul 24 | [Dashboards](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-24-dashboards) | MCP: `list_issues` pagination, replies to comment threads, and fewer truncated responses. |
| Jul 30 | [Agent Interaction Guidelines and SDK](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-07-30-agent-interaction-guidelines-and-sdk) | Developer preview of the Agent Interaction SDK, plus agent delegation semantics. MCP: more cycle details from `list_cycles`. Fix: some webhooks weren't delivered. |
| Aug 14 | [Product Intelligence technology preview](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-08-14-product-intelligence-technology-preview) | MCP: properties can be set and queried by name instead of UUID, `list_users` gets a query filter, `list_issue_labels` is paginated, and tool annotations are exposed. API settings show when a key was last used. |
| Aug 21 | [Cursor agent](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-08-21-cursor-agent) | `issueAddLabel` and `issueRemoveLabel` now return the issue. |
| Sep 4 | [Salesforce](https://linear.app/changelog/2025-09-04-salesforce) | `userEmail` input on `issueSubscribe` and `issueUnsubscribe`. Unauthenticated API requests return 401 instead of 400. OAuth app avatar changes now propagate to app users. |
